blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala finally makes her debut in the Singapore Open main draw on Thursday against Russia’s Tatiana Prozorova at OCBC Arena center court. Eala and Prozorova’s round-of-16 match marks their first-ever meeting. The 22-year-old Prozorova arranged a date with Eala after defeating Belgium’s Sofia Costoulas, 5-7, 7-6(2), 6-2, in the round of 32 on Tuesday.
